newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's consolidation to slow after 97 - Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Spain's consolidation to slow after 97 - Folgado.

text.p: Spain's fiscal consolidation will continue after 1997, but at a slower pace, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Monday.
"The (public) deficit correction will continue but the intensity will not remain the same," Folgado told reporters.
"The biggest part of the adjustment will take place this year," he said.
Folgado said also Spain would continue the systematic restructuring of state-owned companies in deficit and it would rationalise health expenditures.
"We are in a good position to face such structural reforms without major traumas," he said.
